name: Secret Spot Camping
stayType: Campsite run by Croyde Surf Hire
beachAccess: Just behind the Saunton sand dunes
confirmedFeatures: Hot showers, toilets, communal kitchen, campers' shelter with fridge-freezer and microwave, fire pit
overview: A small campsite tucked just behind the Saunton dunes, run by Croyde Surf Hire. Pitches are on flat, rolled fields, and facilities include hot showers, a communal kitchen and a campers' shelter with a fridge-freezer, plus a fire pit and chill-out sofas.
surfTripFit: Run by a surf hire business and sitting right behind the dunes, it is about as close to Saunton's waves as camping gets.
